question: Is the following claim true? The Peace of Westphalia was signed in 1648.
source: author-written for this project; verified by the author

claims.text: The Peace of Westphalia is conventionally dated to 1648.
The Peace comprised the Treaties of Osnabrück and Münster, involving the Empire, Sweden, France, Spain and the Dutch Republic.
The treaties were signed in October 1648.
The treaties ended the Thirty Years' War in the Empire and the Eighty Years' War between Spain and the Dutch Republic.
Standard historical references consistently give 1648 as the date.
Negotiations took place over several years, beginning around 1644-1645.
Some ratifications and implementing steps extended into 1649 or later.
The name refers to a series of agreements rather than a single document, so 'signed in 1648' might be imprecise.
The precision and framing objections do not undermine that the signing occurred in 1648.
The claim that the Peace of Westphalia was signed in 1648 is true.
